name: Patanjali Foods Limited
summary: Patanjali Foods Limited engages in the processing of oil seeds and refining crude oil for edible use in India, Africa, Europe, Australia, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: FMCG; Edible Oils; and Wind Turbine Power Generation. The company offers crude and refined oil; vanaspati, bakery fats, seed extractions, and other related products; mustard, soyabean, sunflower, rice bran, sesame, groundnut, and roasted/virgin coconut oil; palm, castor, and soya derivatives, as well as refined glycerine; and soya value-added products, such as soya flakes, lecithin, textured vegetable protein, grits, flour, TSP, and meal.
